title: Generated vs handwritten equivalence tests
objective: Compare field outputs from generated and handwritten reference solvers.
implementation_steps: Run generated elastic solver on same mesh/BCs as handwritten reference
Run generated plastic solver on same mesh/BCs as handwritten reference
Assert max norm difference below threshold
acceptance_criteria: Max norm difference between generated and handwritten outputs below defined threshold
Both elastic and plastic paths compared

cases: Elastic: generated vs handwritten displacement comparison
Elastic: generated vs handwritten stress comparison
Plastic: generated vs handwritten displacement comparison
Plastic: generated vs handwritten stress comparison

risks: Small numerical differences from CSE/ordering — use tolerance-based comparison
